The '''''Haven''''' was a Mark I [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] [[Assault Frigate Mark I|Assault Frigate]] which served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] between the battles of [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]].

It was present alongside the [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] [[Diligent (Neutron Star-class)|''Diligent'']] at the Rebel base known as [[Lost Station]] where new recruit [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] underwent his piloting evaluations supervised by his future [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] [[Olin Garn]].
